name: loch-extension
description: Loch: a shielded balance inside the Solana wallet you already use. The browser extension and the packages it is built from.

scripts.build:mainnet: pnpm --filter '@loch/extension^...' --workspace-concurrency=1 run build && LOCH_MAINNET_TESTING=1 LOCH_CONNECT_URL=https://connect.lochlayer.com/connect.html LOCH_RELAYER_URL=https://relayer-mainnet.lochlayer.com LOCH_SCREENER_URL=https://screener-mainnet.lochlayer.com pnpm --filter @loch/extension run build
